title: Adaptable Resistance Practice
goal: Explore adaptable Resistance Practice at a comfortable, adaptable level.
readiness: Adult maintains sound standing balance and knee joint stability.
steps: Choose a supported squat, sit-to-stand, wall push or other suitable resistance movement.
Begin with body weight or a manageable light resistance, using a stable support as needed.
Move through a comfortable range while breathing normally; rest before form becomes difficult.
Increase resistance gradually only when the current version is comfortable; seek instruction for loaded techniques.
completionCriteria: Participant tries a suitable resistance movement with a manageable load and comfortable breathing.
safety: Do not use body-weight percentages or maximal lifting as a required target.
Avoid breath holding and stop for pain, dizziness or chest symptoms.
adaptations: Use shorter attempts, accessible materials or additional support.
Adapt the activity to your language, interests, health and current ability; participation does not require unassisted performance.
benefits: Offers adaptable practice with movement or everyday hand skills. Choose support and effort that feel comfortable.

title: Everyday Aerobic Movement
goal: Try an accessible aerobic activity and choose a feasible routine.

completionCriteria: Participant chooses an accessible activity and a feasible next step without a fitness threshold.

Stop for discomfort, fatigue or disengagement; never force movement or a response.
